promptDirective: Create a professional full-body character casting sheet showing exactly three clearly separated equal views of the same character arranged side by side in one horizontal row on a single portrait canvas. Use this fixed left-to-right order: front view facing directly toward the camera, exact side profile facing toward the viewer right, and back view facing directly away from the camera. In the side profile, the face, nose, chest, hips, knees, and toes must all point toward the viewer right; keep the head aligned with the torso and never turn the head toward the camera or opposite the body. Show one complete head-to-feet figure in each view at the same scale, with generous clear margins above the hair and below the feet; never crop the head, hair, arms, hands, legs, or feet. Keep the same recognizable face, hair, skin, and selected body proportions in all three views. Preserve every selected anatomical proportion consistently across the front, exact side, and back views without averaging or normalizing the body shape. Use a neutral upright standing pose, relaxed arms, level eye-height camera, minimal perspective distortion, even studio lighting, and a solid pure white background. Dress the character in an opaque, matte neutral medium-gray, unbranded four-way-stretch jersey casting uniform: a seam-minimal short-sleeve top with a modest high crew neckline and matching mid-thigh shorts. Print a subtle technical contour grid on the gray fabric using thin evenly spaced light-gray horizontal and vertical lines. The grid follows the fabric surface and curves naturally over the exact body contours in every view; it contains no numbers, letters, labels, symbols, logos, or measurement text. Maintain clear tonal separation between the grid uniform, the character's skin, and the pure white background. The close contoured fit must follow the character's exact natural anatomy without compression, padding, reshaping, concealment, or flattening of the upper torso, waist, hips, or seat. The casting uniform provides full modest coverage and is never underwear, lingerie, swimwear, transparent fabric, cleavage-emphasizing clothing, or sexualized styling. Produce an unlabeled image only: no text, captions, words, letters, panel titles, arrows, numbers, borders, dividers, logos, watermark, props, dramatic gestures, extra people, duplicate views, inset panels, or cropped limbs.
